description: Canonical node types for the BTE Knowledge Graph. Specification only — no runtime implementation.

node_types.description: Canonical academic concept represented by a Knowledge Record (typically KR-*).
node_types.notes: Primary graph citizen for foundational and derived knowledge concepts.

node_types.description: Named entity within the canon (person, text unit, or catalogued object) distinct from a Concept node.
node_types.notes: Reserved for non-concept entities; ID pattern is provisional until entity registry exists.

node_types.description: Formal rule node derived from rule database or rule-bearing Knowledge Records.
node_types.notes: Specification placeholder; does not imply engine execution.

node_types.description: Recognized structural or interpretive pattern in BaZi knowledge.
node_types.notes: Distinct from Concept when the unit is a pattern type rather than a foundational concept.

node_types.description: Illustrative or boundary example attached to knowledge (typically EX-*).
node_types.notes: Examples are not academic authorities by themselves.
Aligns with knowledge/bibliography source IDs when present.

node_types.description: Design or publication pack container (e.g. PACK_01).
node_types.notes: Organizational node; not a substitute for Concept identity.
Organizational node under the BaZi module map.
